verification.validation: Focused release gate: Go api unit tests (raw HTTP routes with and without a Portal alias, multi-segment and mismatched PATH_INFO refusals, access decision under the alias) and vet; docs, version and executor manifest checks; Node build. A Portal-alias download and upload observed on a DSM 7.3.2 controller with an App built against this SDK. No full gate, QEMU, executor rebuild, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: Raw HTTP routes (api.HandleHTTP) work under a DSM Application Portal alias: exactly one alias segment may precede SCRIPT_NAME when nginx's PATH_INFO names the same path. Longer prefixes and a differing PATH_INFO are not raw routes; access checks are unchanged.
api.HTTPPath(ctx) returns the path below the CGI inside a HandleHTTP handler, with or without the alias.
Reuse executor 0.53.6 unchanged: executor sources and build inputs are unchanged.
